import zipfile, tempfile, subprocess, os, json, pathlib
z=zipfile.ZipFile('../gnutls_x509_parser_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip')
for n in z.namelist():
    data=z.read(n)
    if len(data)<50: continue
    p=tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False)
    p.write(data); p.close()
    r=subprocess.run(['bash','/workspace/submit.sh',p.name,'/workspace/candidate_trace.json'], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    os.unlink(p.name)
    out=r.stdout.decode('utf-8','ignore')
    if 'exit_code' in out:
        print(n, out.splitlines()[0])
        if '"exit_code":0' not in out:
            print(out[:400]); break
